needs: fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`)

text: The slot holds the head `sentences` for `bioclip2-l14` (species_sci), fitted on `none (sentence rows only)`, with 5911 species rows. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 100, w_kind 0.5, alpha_prior 1. The thresholds are the ones the slot's manifest carries: name_at 0.78 and offer_at 0.67. On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 98.0% (97.6 to 98.4); the top species is right for 92.4% (91.6 to 93.2) and is among the first five for 97.5% (97.0 to 97.9). `person` was said for 0.00% of these photos and `none` for 0.00%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind phrases`. With kind_at 0.50 (as the slot's manifest carries it), the page asserts a kind for 98.1% (97.7 to 98.5) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 98.9% (98.5 to 99.2) of those; for the 1.9% (1.5 to 2.3) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 90.1% (82.7 to 96.3). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds`), the kind is right for 17.0% (14.9 to 19.1); the page asserts a kind for 42.5% (39.6 to 45.2) and is right for 31.5% (27.7 to 35.5) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 13.3% (10.9 to 16.0). A species is named on 11.3% (9.5 to 13.1) of these photos. The slot needs: fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).

outcomes.right: the name is right for 98.2% (97.7 to 98.6); the kind for 99.7% (99.5 to 99.8)
the three hold the species for 91.8% (89.4 to 94.3); the kind is right for 97.3% (95.7 to 98.6)
the kind is right for 66.9% (60.0 to 73.7)

extra.text: The 1240 test photos of the extra set `coco-kinds` (COCO photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms with nothing alive; vectors `images/coco-kinds`) went through the same slot, each with a calendar month drawn by a hash of its id. A species name on a photo of a person or a room is always wrong.
